title: InvPulse
description: InvPulse is a lightweight client-side inventory assistant mod for Minecraft that helps you stay organized without breaking immersion or changing gameplay balance.
body:
**InvPulse** is a lightweight, client-side utility designed to streamline inventory management through visual intelligence. Instead of changing how you play, it enhances your awareness of what you’re carrying, helping you keep your pockets clean and your stacks full without the mental clutter.

_**Key Features**_:
- **Smart Stack Highlighting**: Ever wonder where your space went? InvPulse highlights duplicate items across different slots that could be merged into a single stack but aren't.
- 
- **One-Click Auto-Sorting**: Instantly organize your player inventory and all containers (Chests, Barrels, Shulker Boxes, etc.) with a single button or keypress.
- 
- **Low Stock Warnings**: Perfect for builders and explorers. The mod monitors your "essential" blocks (configurable) and gives you a subtle visual warning when you're about to run out.
- 
- **Junk Detection**: Automatically marks "trash" items (like poisonous potatoes or rotten flesh), so you know exactly what to toss to make room for loot.
- 
- **Seamless Vanilla Aesthetic**: No bulky overlays. Every highlight and icon is designed to look like a natural extension of the default Minecraft UI.

**_Why InvPulse_**?

Managing a messy inventory is the most time-consuming part of Minecraft. InvPulse eliminates the "inventory stare" by telling you exactly what needs your attention. It’s the perfect middle ground between a completely manual inventory and "cheaty" automation mods—giving you the information you need to stay organized effortlessly.

**_Configuration & Usage_**

Everything is fully customizable to fit your playstyle. Toggle specific highlights and set your own "low stock" thresholds.

**Open Settings**: Press the **P key** (default).

**Compatibility**: Works on Forge and is strictly client-side.
